net.minecraftborge.loader

Interface BlockRenderType

  • Functional Interface:
    This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.

    @FunctionalInterface
public interface BlockRenderType
    Block rendering abstraction, by allocating a render type in RenderBlocks a mod can register a custom block model
